articles.summary: Bold Mediterranean flavor and feel-good ingredients take center stage this fall, alongside a larger-than-life celebration coming to New York City. CAVA is channeling Greek Goddess energy with a fresh lineup of offerings built around an all-new Greek Goddess dressing. The latest innovations pair fresh, herby Mediterranean flavors with wholesome ingredients, alongside a seasonal Pomegranate Apple drink. CAVA's new Greek Goddess Salmon Bowl To celebrate the launch — and prove it’s no myth that big flavor and healthful choices go hand in hand — CAVA is taking inspiration from the ancient Greeks themselves, with a one-of-a-kind Greek Goddess arriving in New York City tomorrow. The center of the celebration? CAVA’s new Greek Goddess dressing, a tangy blend of rich Greek yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, herbs, and spices. The new dressing serves as the crowning touch on two new curated bowls, bringing a fresh twist to CAVA’s Mediterranean menu. Meet the Greek Goddess Lineup Greek Goddess Salmon
articles.title: CAVA’s New Greek Goddess Menu Is Not a Myth, Just Mediterranean
